title: Reduced Payment Plan Payment-Record Points: Questions on the Twelve-Month Record
content:
**Rule.** For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan on which the scheduled-installment payments posted in the twelve calendar months before the decision date, less the scheduled-installment payments returned in those months, number at least 11 earns 3 points; a loan on which they number at least 6 but fewer than 11 earns 1 point; any other loan earns none. A payment dated exactly twelve months before the decision date falls outside those months; a payment counts as inside those twelve months when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the decision date. Each point is one percentage point off the percentage at which the Reduced Payment Plan installment is set.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which payments are counted?** Payments of the scheduled-installment type posted to the loan in its Personal Loans payment ledger within the twelve months; additional-principal or other payment types are not counted.

**How do returned payments enter?** Each scheduled-installment payment returned within the same twelve months reduces the count by one.

**What are the bands?**

| Net scheduled-installment payments in the twelve months | Points |
|---|---|
| 11 or more | 3 |
| 6 to 10 | 1 |
| 5 or fewer | none |

**Where is the edge of the twelve months?** With a decision date of 20 June (hypothetical), a payment dated 21 June of the previous year is inside (fewer than twelve whole months); one dated 20 June of the previous year is exactly twelve months back and outside.

**A hypothetical count:** 12 payments posted and 2 returned in the twelve months give a net 10, which earns 1 point; 12 posted and 1 returned give 11, which earns 3 points.
